items.title: Crocodile Spotted At Kukkarahalli Lake
items.snippet_en: A crocodile was spotted at the bank of Kukkarahalli Lake recently, triggering panic among morning walkers, according to an article from January 28, 2026.

items.title: Crocodile sighted in Kukkarahalli Lake
items.snippet_en: A huge crocodile was sighted near the fishermen's shed close to Hunsur Main Road on December 1, 2024. This is not the first time a crocodile has been sighted in Kukkarahalli Lake.

items.title: Crocodile spotted in Kukkarahalli Lake
items.snippet_en: In September 2023, morning walkers were worried after spotting a crocodile in Kukkarahalli Lake. The Forest Department had previously rescued crocodiles from the lake.

items.title: Giant crocodile appears near Mysore lake
items.snippet_en: A giant crocodile was spotted on the Kukkarahalli Lake bund in March 2010, reaffirming the presence of crocodiles in the lake.

outputs.notes_en: The sources confirm that crocodiles have been sighted in Kukkarahalli Lake multiple times over the years, including recently in January 2026 and December 2024. However, none of the sources specifically mention two crocodiles being seen 'yesterday evening' (October 7, 2026). Therefore, the sources provide context about the presence of crocodiles in the lake but do not directly support or contradict the specific timing and number mentioned in the claim.
